verdicts.why: Reads the 'unfortunate development' gloss as light regret with no loss behind it; stays in the word, negative fits, example fits.
Same gloss as pity, distinguished by a note of protest; inside the word, negative fits, the Austen example is this sense.
Takes the gloss's 'great loss' and says what the word adds (grief, waste, mourning); negative fits.
Covers both halves of the gloss (emotion and enthusiasm) and names the deficiency reading; negative fits.
Describes the absence of emotional reaction the gloss names and contrasts stolidity within the same synset; mild negative is plausible; example fits.
Same lack of interest and energy read as mood rather than fault, which justifies the neutral charge against a negative family.
Register label plus a reading of the gloss's lack of energy as drained away; negative fits.
Plain naming of the gloss's want of interest and energy, differentiated from its two synonyms; negative fits.
Reads the absent reaction as dullness of feeling, which is the apathy gloss; negative fits.

Keeps to the gloss's 'supports or champions something' and distinguishes backing from relief; positive fits.
Warm informal register, a standing source of help, advice and encouragement; positive fits; both examples are this figurative sense.
Flat classification by the child-bearing sex matches the gloss; neutral fits; contrasts stay inside the neighbouring words.
